description: Per-TLD bootstrap data, from IANA sources

tld.remarks:
The .localhost domain is typically configured to point to your device, i.e. to IP address 127.0.0.1 (IPv4) or ::1 (IPv6). This is known as a loopback, and it is widely used in software development and testing when an application needs to connect to another service running on the same device.

For further information, see [Special-Use Domain Names](https://www.iana.org/go/rfc6761#section-6.5) (RFC 6761) and [Reserved Top Level DNS Names](https://www.iana.org/go/rfc2606) (RFC 2606).
